purpose: Determine SAM 3.1 conditioning/adaptation options for VOID quadmask intake, define a measurable VOID benchmark, and choose mixed-precision and calibration strategy.

terminology.ensemble_calibration: Label-free Dawid-Skene agreement calibration in samurai; it changes expert weights, never SAM or VOID weights.
terminology.quantization_calibration: Representative activation/statistic collection for numeric formats; it does not teach new mask semantics.
terminology.supervised_fine_tuning: Gradient training from paired masks or counterfactual target videos; this is the only option that changes model behavior.

void_semantics_mapping.primary_0_and_overlap_63: SAM 3.1 can track the primary object, but samurai currently OR-collapses multiple objects and max-collapses their scalar object probabilities; role-aware output preservation is still needed.
void_semantics_mapping.affected_127: Netflix VOID itself used the SAM 3 image model for this lane: VLM-selected affected nouns are segmented, gridified, and proximity-filtered into the grey mask. Reusing that pattern is lower risk than forcing SAM 3.1 multiplex to emit all VOID classes.
void_semantics_mapping.overlap_63: No native SAM output; compute downstream as primary intersect affected.
void_semantics_mapping.boundary: No native prompt; derive from mask distance transforms or an added boundary expert.

recommended_conditioning_ladder.change: Run SAM 3.1 multiplex as the primary dense anchor and the SAM 3 image model as the affected-region lane, then apply the existing quadmask intersection rule.
recommended_conditioning_ladder.gate: Full-video primary/affected per-class IoU and boundary F1 must beat the current text-box vision panel on held-out VOID samples.

recommended_conditioning_ladder.change: Preserve object IDs, per-object masks, and per-object scores; convert high-disagreement regions into point or box prompts rather than trying add_mask.
recommended_conditioning_ladder.gate: A/B no-escalation versus disagreement-escalated SAM 3.1 on the same frames.

recommended_conditioning_ladder.change: Fine-tune the SAM 3 image affected-region model on generated VOID-domain noun/mask pairs; keep SAM 3.1 multiplex frozen initially.
recommended_conditioning_ladder.gate: Held-out affected-region IoU and downstream VOID judge score must improve without losing negative prompts.

recommended_conditioning_ladder.change: Widen a SAM semantic head and training target to four quadmask classes.
recommended_conditioning_ladder.gate: This breaks the shipped one-channel semantic head and SAM 3.1 multiplex has no ready video fine-tune recipe; do not attempt before the prompt-role route is measured.

training_and_quantization_corpus_format.sampling_rule: Split by sequence, never by frame. Cover all four quadmask classes, static and fast motion, camera motion, boundaries, early/high-noise and late/low-noise diffusion timesteps, conditional and unconditional CFG branches, and both VOID passes.

strix.supports_fp8_and_fp4_kernels: plausible and previously exercised with torch 2.14.1/CUDA 13.4; still must be probed in the pinned VOID environment

INT8_weight_only.reason_to_choose: Broad Ampere compatibility, simple activation-free calibration, and lower checkpoint residency.
INT8_weight_only.reason_not_to_choose: It dequantizes to BF16 before the GEMM in common paths, so it is primarily memory/storage, not speed.

INT8_W8A8.reason_to_choose: Ampere tensor-core acceleration is possible; selective SAM ConvRot artifacts report real RTX 3090 speedups.
INT8_W8A8.gate: Requires supported kernels and real mask-quality validation; publisher spot checks are insufficient.

FP8_W8A8_dynamic.reason_to_choose: Usually better accuracy than FP4 and useful weight residency on Blackwell.
FP8_W8A8_dynamic.measured_sm120_microbench: Prior receipt measured only 1.12x for a SAM3 trunk shape, 0.92x for a CogVideoX projection, and 0.12x for latency-bound T5-XXL; FP8 is not automatically fast.
FP8_W8A8_dynamic.hardware_boundary: Not a native tensor-core path on B550; the official CogVideo FP8 recipe also pins a newer TorchAO/H100-oriented software surface.

NVFP4_W4A4.reason_to_choose: Only this measured path engaged native FP4 tensor cores and gave 5.4-7.4x GEMM speedups at SAM/VOID/T5 shapes.
NVFP4_W4A4.quality_risk: Layer-level thresholded-mask IoU was only 0.923-0.940; one activation outlier inflated static relative error to about 0.90 while trimmed calibration reduced it to about 0.43.

VAE.reason: The 215M-parameter VAE is only 0.43 GiB in BF16 and is convolution-heavy with non-16-divisible input/output channels; activation-only dynamic quantization can add casts without accelerating the convolution. Tiling/slicing and profiling come first.

component_policy: T5 encoder: qualify FP8 or INT8 first because it uses the stock transformers loader and is primarily a residency win.

SAM 3.1: on B550 use selective INT8/W8A8; on Strix compare BF16, hosted/prequantized FP8, and selective W8A8 while keeping embeddings, norms, geometry, convolutions, and sensitive heads high precision.
VOID DiT: first qualify FP8/W8A8 for quality and residency; only then build custom NVFP4 W4A4 with timestep-binned trimmed activation scales and a fused/low-rank outlier path.
VAE: BF16 plus tiling/slicing until profiling proves it is a bottleneck.
Fusion/calibration core: remains NumPy/BF16-scale probability logic and is not a model-quantization target.
quality_gates: SAM: no pooled mask-IoU regression on the local VOID corpus, no per-sequence J&F regression, and no negative-prompt regression.
VOID synthetic paired set: report PSNR/SSIM, LPIPS/DreamSim/DINOv2, VLM judge, and FVD separately; a single LPIPS win is not acceptance.
VOID real set: preservation, residual removal, temporal stability, and judge criteria must all pass.
Efficiency: report median and p95 latency, peak/steady VRAM, host RAM, and output digest on fixed seeds.
No low-bit variant is accepted from GEMM error or publisher spot metrics alone.
